reply_text:
I can't schedule recurring posts from here. I have no scheduling tool in this conversation, so I can't promise the digest will appear every Monday.

Bettina, here is what I can do:
- **On request:** ping me on a Monday morning and I'll post the "Coastal week ahead" digest here. It would cover the previous week's messages from #coastal-team and #coastal-random, plus open customer items. You're a member of both channels, so you can see everything I'd read.
- **Automatic posting:** someone with access to the platform's scheduler would need to set up a Monday 08:00 job. The first one would be Monday, Oct 19 if the request was made on Oct 14, or Oct 26 if it's made now.

If you'd like a digest now, say so and I'll post one covering last week.
